issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

enableTracing.description:
By default, all tracing is disabled.
If True, tracing is enabled

disableExceptionRecording.description:
By default, spans record exceptions.
If True, spans will not record exceptions.

disableAggregationErrors.description:
By default, if there are any errors during aggregation of span attribute values to trace, the system will raise the error.
If True, aggregation errors are not raised.

enableBatching.description:
By default, in-memory OpenTelemetry spans are upserted into {@link Observability.Span.Record}s when
a span is completed.
If True, spans are collected in an in-memory queue and upserted into {@link Observability.Span.Record}s periodically.

maxQueueSize.description:
If {@link #enableBatching} is True, sets the maximum in-memory queue size for collecting spans.
The queue will be flushed before {@link #scheduleMillis} if the queue size exceeds maxQueueSize

scheduleMillis.description:
If {@link #enableBatching} is True, sets the periodicity of batch upserts.
i.e If {@link #scheduleMillis} is 100, then every 100 ms the in-memory queue is drained.

maxBatchSize.description:
If {@link #enableBatching} is True, sets the batch size for upserts.
If there are 600 spans in in-memory queue, they are upserted into DB in batches of maxBatchSize i.e 256.
i.e There will be 3 batch upserts for upserting 600 spans.

timeoutMillis.description:
If {@link #enableBatching} is True, sets the timeout for each batch of in-memory span export to DB.
Each batch needs to be exported to DB within this timeout.

traceRecordTtl.description:
Time to live for the trace and its spans.
Traces and spans older than this duration are deleted from persisted store if {@link #enableCleanUp} is set to True.

enableCleanUp.description: Whether to enable cleaning of old traces.
